name: Santervás de Campos (Spain)
description: A white saltire throughout on a field divided per saltire, blue above and below and red at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Santervás de Campos.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag of the municipality of Santervás de Campos were approved by its town council on 10 May 2012; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a full white saltire, the upper and lower triangles blue and those of the hoist and fly red, charged over all at the centre with the municipal arms in their colours.

features.role: Santervás de Campos arms — crossed swords on red and a ship on blue
